newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia stocks seen lower on Dow, gold falls.
newsitem.headline: Australia stocks seen lower on Dow, gold falls.

text.p: *Stocks lower on Wall Street fall and gold losses. "I think we are going to follow the Dow and gold has lost a bit, so I think we are going to be generally weaker," one broker said.
*The Dow Industrials skidded to sharp losses amid signs investors were starting to seek opportunities beyond blue chips. The Dow fell 120 points to close at 7842.
*ADRs: News Corp 19-1/4 (-1/4), BHP 27-/13 (-/12), WMC 23-/11 (-/02), National Australia Bank 72-7/8 (+0-5/8).
*Gold prices fell again and world copper prices dropped sharply on signs of a buildup in stocks, but lead, zinc and aluminium all rose. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
